name: Peacock Temple Kanchipuram Silk
shortDescription: Handcrafted by master weavers featuring pure silver-electroplated gold zari temple gopuram border, geometric diamond bands, and deep peacock-emerald 3-ply mulberry silk.
weaverStory: Loomed over 18 days by the Varadharaja Weaver Collective in Pillaiyarpalayam using traditional three-shuttle Korvai interlocking (GI-144).

name: Royal Magenta & Gold Uppada Jamdani
weaveSubtitle: Uppada Jamdani Silk • Hand-drawn Floral Buttas
shortDescription: Featherlight Uppada silk woven with intricate non-mechanical Jamdani floral buttas across a luminous royal magenta body and broad antique silver-gold zari border.
weaverStory: Handwoven by coastal artisans in East Godavari, Andhra Pradesh using age-old Jamdani extra-weft tapestry techniques.

name: Crimson & Obsidian Pochampally Ikat
weaveSubtitle: Natural Dyed Silk • Double Ikat Weave
shortDescription: Traditional tie-and-dye Double Ikat silk saree featuring crisp diamond lattice geometry in crimson red, mustard ochre, and deep obsidian black with a crimson zari selvedge.
weaverStory: Created through the 12-stage Pagdu Bandhu resist-dyeing process in Bhoodan Pochampally before a single thread touches the loom.

name: Nizam Border Sage & Mustard Mangalagiri
weaveSubtitle: Artisanal Cotton Silk • Nizam Zari Selvedge
shortDescription: Breathable 80-count Mangalagiri cotton-silk body in warm turmeric mustard contrasted with a sage-grey selvedge and dense Nizam gold zari brocade border.
weaverStory: Woven on pit looms near the historic Narasimha Swamy temple in Guntur district, famed for crisp gapless weave density.

name: Maroon & Temple Gold Narayanpet Silk
weaveSubtitle: Pure Narayanpet Silk • Rudraksha Temple Border
shortDescription: Classic bridal and festive Narayanpet pure silk saree in auspicious deep maroon with a contrasting gold Rudraksha-and-temple border. Lightweight drape ideal for long wedding rituals.
weaverStory: Introduced under Maratha patronage in the 17th century, eight sarees are warped simultaneously on long street looms in Narayanpet.

name: Emerald & Zari Kasuti Mysore Crepe Silk
weaveSubtitle: Pure Crepe de Chine Silk • Minimalist Zari Lines
shortDescription: Fluid pure Mysore crepe silk in jewel-toned emerald green finished with sleek woven gold zari bands and delicate mango-paisley pallu accents.
weaverStory: Spun from high-twist bivoltine mulberry silk yarns in Karnataka for signature wrinkle resistance and liquid movement.

name: Sapphire & Peacock Kuttu Gadwal Silk
weaveSubtitle: Silk-Cotton Body • Pure Silk Kuttu Temple Border
shortDescription: Traditional Gadwal handloom combining a comfortable teal-blue sico body with a hand-interlocked pure silk antique gold temple border and hamsa motifs.
weaverStory: Famous for being foldable to the size of a matchbox while retaining a grand bridal zari pallu interlocked by hand.

specs.fabricBase: Gadwal Sico with Pure Silk Border

name: Sindoor Red Kadwa Katan Banarasi Silk
weaveSubtitle: Pure Katan Mulberry Silk • Kadwa Jangla Brocade
shortDescription: Heirloom Varanasi Katan silk in radiant bridal sindoor red woven with non-cut Kadwa gold zari floral jaal and classic Mughal kalka borders.
weaverStory: Woven in Madanpura, Varanasi without floating threads on the reverse so every motif sits crisp and snag-free.

name: Ivory & Rose Zari Chanderi Silk Cotton
weaveSubtitle: Sheer Chanderi Pattu • Ashrafi Coin Buttis
shortDescription: Gossamer-light warm ivory Chanderi silk-cotton dotted with traditional gold ashrafi coin buttis and a delicate lotus-rose selvedge.
weaverStory: Handwoven in historic Chanderi using un-degummed raw silk warp that imparts a signature crystalline shimmer.

name: Raw Honey & Indigo Tribal Bhagalpuri Tussar
weaveSubtitle: Wild Gicha Tussar Silk • Geometric Pallu
shortDescription: Richly textured wild Bhagalpuri Tussar silk in natural golden honey beige paired with an indigo-and-madder geometric handwoven pallu.
weaverStory: Reeled from wild forest cocoons in Bihar, giving every yard organic slub texture and breathable warmth.

name: Antique Bronze & Peacock Dharmavaram Silk
weaveSubtitle: Double-Shade Shot Silk • Broad Temple Pallu
shortDescription: Dual-tone Dharmavaram bridal silk shifting between antique bronze and emerald olive under warm light, anchored by sculpted temple borders.
weaverStory: Crafted in Sri Sathya Sai district, Andhra Pradesh, prized for muted heirloom gold tones and durable bridal weight.

name: Terracotta & Mustard Kandaangi Chettinad Cotton
weaveSubtitle: Pure Combed Cotton • Dramatic Kandaangi Checks
shortDescription: Crisp Karaikudi Kandaangi cotton featuring dramatic framing borders in mustard and black around an earthy terracotta checked body.
weaverStory: Revived by Chettinad weaver cooperatives preserving the iconic high-contrast architectural border proportions.
